name: The Sprouted Fronds
label: Quest
description: At Denalan's garden by Lake Al'Ameth, the planted frond has taken root and sprouted. Travelers can see the new growth among the garden beds.

clips.title: The story
paras: At Denalan's garden by Lake Al'Ameth, the planted frond has taken root and sprouted. Travelers can see the new growth among the garden beds.

You find Denalan's garden near Lake Al'Ameth, where the botanist studies Teldrassil's peculiar plants. After a shimmering frond is planted, new fronds rise from the soil in his planter, ready to be gathered and examined.

Teldrassil is young and vast, and its plant life grows quickly. Night elf herbalists find that growth fascinating and troubling. The shimmering fronds and their offshoots show how quickly life takes hold on the World Tree's boughs, though its vitality can be hard to predict.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The fronds Denalan planted within his garden have sprouted and grown. They tremble, eager to be picked....
